components.content:
## Key Information

**Applicable to:**
- Drinking supply water systems
- Sewer or toilet facilities systems

**Locations:**
- Homes
- Offices
- Factories
- Schools
- Hospitals

**Important Notes:**
- Codes are adopted and altered by local authorities to fit local needs
- Throughout the world, different countries and jurisdictions have their own local or common (as within EU) set of codes
- Engineers must always check and adapt to the local regime
